about: Checked by tests/test_example_synthetic_pump_probe.py. Units: delay in ps; intensities are ROI means divided by the first delay; shifts are centre-of-mass differences (laser on minus laser off, unless named poff_) in detector pixels; 1 px = q_per_px 1/Angstrom.

truth.about: The response the generator injects into laser-on shots: intensity factor 1 - 0.25 (1 - exp(-t/1.5 ps)) and x shift 1.5 (1 - exp(-t/3 ps)) px for t > 0, nothing for t <= 0. Laser-off shots carry no response.

regression.about: What the reduction returns today at seed 0 (not the truth): a change here means the reduction changed.
